messages:
Avery Chen (CEO): Quick exec pulse — three focal points this week:
1) Launch readiness: Private GA checklist needs final pass (security, install docs, upgrade playbook).
2) Reliability: keep hosted p95 <= 200ms for paid plans; p50 target <= 60ms.
3) Economics: new cost target is 15% unit reduction on chat traffic within 6 weeks. Ops + Eng, propose owners by Wed.
See short playbook: https://redwood.example.com/internal/exec/5387 :rocket:

Jordan Lee (VP Eng): Noted. Quick recap from last week's incident: root cause was a KV-cache eviction bug under burst. We patched and rolled back the bad optimizer change. Full RCA in #postmortems later today.

Priya Reddy (VP Product): For Private GA we also need the data-retention defaults clarified. Proposal: hosted logs default 30d, enterprise opt-in 90d. This affects Console UX and billing lines. Sending the PR now.

Samir Patel (Head of Security): Security signoff condition: documented encryption key rotation process + audit log for install. If the PR includes the rotation steps, I can sign off by Thu morning. Also want CI scan results attached to the checklist.

Leah Kim (Finance): If Eng confirms 15% is feasible, Finance will reallocate $150k/mo to Dedicated capacity for Q3. Also recommend a $25k customer credit pool for any rollout fallout — ops to own spend guardrails.

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): Running a final canary for the rollout now. I'll post results and perf snapshots here.

deploy-bot: Rolling canary: release/2026-03-24 -> canary-a (4 hosts).

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): running smoke suite:
```
./infra/smoke.sh --env=canary-a --suite=throughput --concurrency=50
```
Posting short stats in 15m.

Jordan Lee (VP Eng): On cost plan: Eng will own batching (Jordan), quant/compilation experiments (Tom from Platform), prefix-caching (Ops-Optimize). I'll create an RFC with milestones and owners by Tue EOD.

Tom Brewer (Platform PM): (via Jordan) Tom will track quant results and provide perf/cost delta table for each model variant. ETA 2 weeks for first batch.

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): Smoke update: no 5xx, p95=172ms under staged load, CPU on host-2 spiked to 82% briefly. Full logs attached to the canary ticket. Snippet:
```
[INFO] canary-a | 200 OK | p95=172ms | cpu_host_2=82%
```

Avery Chen (CEO): Good. Two tactical asks before EOD Fri:
- Product + Security: update Private GA checklist with explicit signoff lines and attach CI scan link.
- Eng + Finance: confirm owners and a realistic roadmap for the 15% cost reduction (deliverables + checkpoints).
Also: hiring note — we will pause external recruiting for non-critical IC roles next sprint to protect runway. People-ops will send a separate note.

Priya Reddy (VP Product): Will add signoff lines and attach the PR + CI link.

Samir Patel (Head of Security): Ill review the PR when the rotation doc is added.

Leah Kim (Finance): Copying budget ops. Well mark the $150k reallocation as conditional on Eng confirmation.

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): Canary healthy. ready for staged rollout when Product signals GA.

deploy-bot: Canary complete  canary-a healthy across 4 hosts.

Avery Chen (CEO): Thanks team. Focus on measurable progress this sprint: reliability, a clear GA checklist, and a defensible cost plan. Flag blockers early. :white_check_mark:

Jordan Lee (VP Eng): +1

Priya Reddy (VP Product): :handshake:

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): will post full post-canary summary by EOD.
